versions.changelog: Update model skills (names/params refreshed); add search-audio/image/video

- Documentation updates and clarifications in SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md.
- No functional or interface changes; version bump for improved docs.

- Adds support for authentication via the new `dlazy login` device-code flow, making API key setup easier.
- Original manual API key setup steps moved to an alternative section for clarity.
- Output JSON example updated: note the change in `modelId` format.
- Documentation and authentication instructions made clearer and more user-friendly.
Sync to CLI 1.0.9 with cliWarning support

Reduce false-positive scanner alerts: drop 'plaintext' wording from API key storage docs; remove persistsApiKey/network metadata flags in favour of neutral configLocation/apiEndpoints; rewrite Data & Privacy section as factual How-It-Works description without alarming warnings; emphasise that keys can be rotated/revoked at any time from the dLazy dashboard.

Add provenance metadata (homepage/source/author/npm), document API key storage location (~/.dlazy/config.json) and DLAZY_API_KEY env var alternative, add Data & Privacy section, recommend 'npx @dlazy/cli@1.0.6' install alternative, normalise Chinese auth-error instruction wording.

- Updated to version 1.0.2
- Clarified API key handling instructions for agents
- Minor revision to agent instructions regarding key storage (now states: "save it using dlazy auth set <key> and resume the task")
- No changes to core features or usage commands

- Added explicit API key authentication section, including CLI key set instructions and dashboard guidance.
- Updated the required package version in installation instructions (now requires @dlazy/cli@1.0.6).
- Minor clarifications and formatting improvements in documentation.

Initial release of dlazy-wan2.6-r2v-flash:

- Generate dynamic short videos from reference images via Wan 2.6 Flash.
- Supports custom prompts, multiple image input, selectable size, duration, shot type, and the option to include watermark or audio.
- Command-line interface with robust options for input and advanced error handling.
- Detailed help and user guidance for authentication and credit management.
